Wash-Test Results for the TRITAN UV-Printed Configuration

For model HJB-001 in its tested TRITAN UV-printed configuration, home dishwasher durability is 200–300 cycles without colour loss; the special ink upgrade reaches up to 500 cycles. Commercial high-temperature, strong-alkali washing lasts about 100–150 cycles. These results do not apply to silicone cups or to other material configurations of this model.
